title: Petrol price down by Rs2.93 per litre, high-speed diesel rate up by Re0.61
summary: The government on Monday reduced the price of petrol by Rs2.93 per litre, but increased that of high-speed diesel (HSD) by Re0.61 per litre. Following the revision, petrol will retail at Rs395.37 per litre, while HSD will cost Rs396.85 per litre. The government continues to levy Rs114 per litre in taxes and duties on petrol and Rs100 per litre on diesel. According to the Petroleum Division’s notification, the new prices are applicable for Oct 13 (Tuesday). The price of HSD has come down from a peak of Rs520.35 recorded on April 3. title: Educational institutions in Peshawar to remain open on Tuesday, BRT services to be restored
summary: All educational institutions in Peshawar will remain open on Tuesday, a statement by the city’s deputy commissioner (DC) has announced. The statement, posted on Facebook, urged the public not to pay heed to any “fake notification or rumours” in this regard. Educational institutions in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa’s provincial capital remained closed on Monday amid road blocks following the imposition of governor’s rule in the province. Police personnel remained present on roads in the city on Monday, with heavier deployment where the Cantonment limit began. Meanwhile, TransPeshawar, which manages the city’s BRT transport system, has announced that services would be restored from October 13 (Tuesday).
